policy_source: Army COOL Funding Guide (representative demo model)
source_note: Policy values are representative for demonstration purposes. Actual eligibility varies by service branch and current DoD guidance.

notes: TA pays up to $4,000 per fiscal year for college coursework
Service member must have enough remaining time to use TA
Some Army aviation credentials may have lower allowable funding caps

mos_aligned_exception.description: When a credential directly supports the service member's existing MOS, it may be funded as professional military education outside normal COOL/CA limits
mos_aligned_exception.applies_when: Domain Alignment is green/high — credential maps to current MOS duties
mos_aligned_exception.effect: Credential may not consume CA slots or count against COOL limits

notes: Army COOL may fund up to 3 credentials per 10-year period, with max ~$2,000 per credential
Actual funding approvals vary by credential and service policy requirements
Exception: MOS-aligned credentials may qualify for in-service military education funding outside CA limits
SkillBridge eligibility and sponsor availability vary by installation

general_notes: Policy data is demo-mode representative. Actual eligibility may differ by branch, MOS, and current regulations.
System uses these policy constraints to generate warnings, flags, and feasibility assessments.
